_comment: Deployed 2026-10-14. Every value below was read back from chain after the broadcast.
_decimalsNote: On Arc the native gas unit is 18-decimal while the USDC ERC-20 interface is 6-decimal. They are the same balance, 1e12 apart. Never render a treasury balance from eth_getBalance.

gas._floorNote: Transactions below the 20 Gwei floor are silently dropped with no receipt. If no receipt arrives, check the nonce before re-broadcasting.

PolicyVault._signerNote: botSigner is fixed at registerBot and has no setter. setAgent rotates caller authority only. Verify botSigner equals the signing key BEFORE the owner grants any allowance.

verification._note: Both contracts are an exact match (creation and runtime bytecode) on Sourcify. Blockscout at explorer.arc.io/api was tried first and refused by a Cloudflare challenge before reaching the verifier, so the explorer itself may still show them as unverified.

notClaimed.threeWayMatch: No order, delivery or receipt attestation in this deploy. The vault enforces who, how much and how often — not whether the work was done.
notClaimed.vetoQueue: No delay queue and no per-payment human approval. A payment inside policy settles immediately.
notClaimed.cctp: No destination leg. TokenMessengerV2 is live on 5042 but PolicyVault does not call it. Payees must be on Arc.
notClaimed.factory: One vault, one owner, one agent. No multi-business tier and no self-serve deployment.
notClaimed.recordsAreNotPayments: Every payment publishes a record in the same transaction, but TrackRecordV2.publish is permissionless, so a record alone is not a payment. Paid events are the payment ledger.
notClaimed.arcSpecificBehaviour: Arc's runtime blocklist is covered by a mock in the test suite. forge test runs a stock EVM and forge script's dry run does too, so Arc-specific reverts only surface on broadcast.
